items.briefing:
Australian education platform Mathspace has suffered a significant data breach affecting over one million students, parents, and teachers. Personal information has been exposed, making this highly relevant to anyone connected to schools or training organisations using the platform — including potentially staff at registered training organisations. If you or your organisation uses Mathspace, be alert for phishing emails or suspicious contact using your personal details.

AI-powered scams are also becoming harder to detect, with artificial intelligence making fraudulent messages and calls increasingly convincing. Be extra cautious with unexpected emails, texts, or calls — even if they seem personal or professional. **Tip:** If you receive an unexpected message asking for information or action, verify the request by contacting the sender directly through a known, trusted channel.

featured.title: Mathspace breach exposed data of more than 1 million students, parents and teachers
